analysis_provenance.quantile_method: Exact NumPy linear quantiles via in-place memory-mapped partition
analysis_provenance.statistical_population: Only unique train_background representatives; no validation/test feature statistics

development_subset.rounding: floor separately per background train/validation role

integrity.capacity_note: Impossible in the validated fixed-width 700-slot schema

object_view.selection_rule: Smallest candidate with truncation <= 1% and event-mean lost scalar pT <= 0.1%
object_view.ordering: Descending float64 source pT; ascending eta, wrapped phi, original slot for ties

preprocessing.scaling_convention: Population std (ddof=0), fitted in float64; particle scalers weight valid training particles equally; aggregate scalers weight training events equally
